# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No code changes were required in this apply-fixes pass. The cycle-2 round-7 review returned `approved` with no follow-up amendments, so I left the shrimp routing and oxygen-budget bookkeeping implementation unchanged and revalidated the current workspace state.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the round-7 review outcome and current worktree state to confirm there were no requested follow-up fixes for the shrimp feeding loop or related budget-accounting changes.
2. [Skipped] Skipped code edits because the latest review was approved and no additional amendments were requested.
3. [Completed] Re-ran targeted and full `tank_core` validation, then checked worktree status to confirm the approved implementation still passes in the current workspace state.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test save_load --test shrimp_feeding_pathway` passed (28 tests total).
- `cargo test -p tank_core` passed in full across lib, integration, and doc-test targets.
- `git status --short` shows no tracked-file changes; only the pre-existing untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory remains.

## Outstanding Risks

- The worktree still contains the pre-existing untracked `.ralph-burning/` directory, which remains outside the scope of this bead.
